glyph.materials: Ink plus parchment; use the matching ink tier or Ink of the Sea exchange path
glyph.notes: Curated level-80 build glyph. Post singles first; duplicates are for restocking, not bulk dumping.

stat-scroll.materials: 1 Ink of the Sea + 2 Resilient Parchment produces 2 scrolls
stat-scroll.notes: Also appears as loot, but Inscription can manufacture the same tradeable item. Do not confuse it with drop-only Protection scrolls.

runescroll.materials: 1 Snowfall Ink + 5 Resilient Parchment produces 5 scrolls
runescroll.notes: Raid-buff substitute when a Priest is unavailable. Check whether the server's buff stacking matches normal 3.3.5 behavior.

armor-vellum.materials: 1 Ink of the Sea + 2 Resilient Parchment produces 2 vellums
armor-vellum.notes: Rank III stores WotLK armor enchants for AH sale. Sell useful small stacks.

weapon-vellum.materials: 3 Ink of the Sea + 2 Resilient Parchment produces 2 vellums
weapon-vellum.notes: Rank III stores WotLK weapon enchants for AH sale. Usually slower than Armor Vellum III.

certificate.notes: Hunter pet-renaming utility. Niche, but genuinely tradeable and useful.

boe-offhand.materials: High-level inks, parchment, and supporting reagents
boe-offhand.notes: BoE level-77 caster off-hand. Treat as a slow gearing item and craft one at a time.

nobles-card.materials: Random output from Darkmoon Card of the North
nobles-card.notes: Greatness-set card. Exact-card scarcity matters more than average card cost.

chaos-card.materials: Random output from Darkmoon Card of the North
chaos-card.notes: Berserker-set card. Singles mainly sell to players finishing a deck.

prisms-card.materials: Random output from Darkmoon Card of the North
prisms-card.notes: Illusion-set card. Singles mainly sell to players finishing a deck.

undeath-card.materials: Random output from Darkmoon Card of the North
undeath-card.notes: Death-set card. Demand is better than the other non-Nobles sets but still completion-driven.

nobles-deck.notes: Tradeable deck used for the Greatness trinket quest. The rewarded trinket is not an AH item.

other-deck.materials: Ace through Eight of the matching set
other-deck.notes: Tradeable completed deck. Do not price it from Nobles/Greatness demand.

engineering-part.materials: Current live cost of the recipe's Engineering reagents; add only a convenience margin

engineering-explosive.materials: Current live cost of the recipe's metals, powders, and triggers; price per finished unit

engineering-ammo.materials: Current live cost of the recipe's metal and Engineering components; use the listed stack guidance

engineering-powder.materials: Current live cost of the matching stones or motes; add a small convenience margin

alchemy-flask.materials: Current live cost of the matching herbs, Frost Lotus, and Enchanted Vial; price per finished flask

alchemy-potion.materials: Current live cost of the matching herbs, oils, and Crystal Vial; price per finished potion

alchemy-oil.materials: Current live cost of Pygmy Suckerfish; account for the recipe's variable oil yield

alchemy-transmute.materials: Current live cost of the required Primals; add only a convenience margin because cooldown scarcity may not apply

glyph-hammer-righteous.name: Glyph of Hammer of the Righteous

glyph-tricks-trade.name: Glyph of Tricks of the Trade

eng-handful-of-cobalt-bolts.name: Handful of Cobalt Bolts
eng-handful-of-cobalt-bolts.notes: Core Wrath Engineering part made from Cobalt Bar. Used all over 375-450 recipes.

eng-volatile-blasting-trigger.name: Volatile Blasting Trigger
eng-volatile-blasting-trigger.notes: Used in Box of Bombs and other Wrath crafts. Often moves better than raw Cobalt if supply is thin.

eng-froststeel-tube.name: Froststeel Tube
eng-froststeel-tube.notes: Made from Cobalt Bar and Cobalt Bolts. Used for scopes and higher Wrath recipes.

eng-overcharged-capacitor.name: Overcharged Capacitor
eng-overcharged-capacitor.notes: Used in Engineering quests/crafts and occasional leveling paths. Niche but recognizable.

eng-explosive-decoy.name: Explosive Decoy
eng-explosive-decoy.notes: Useful Engineering craft component/utility item. Slow but sells if nobody lists it.

eng-gnomish-army-knife.name: Gnomish Army Knife
eng-gnomish-army-knife.notes: Useful tool/reagent-kit item. Usually sells as convenience to Engineers/alts.

eng-saronite-bomb.name: Saronite Bomb
eng-saronite-bomb.notes: Useful to Engineers and sometimes raid/PvP players depending on this server's rules. Do not flood 8-day walls.

eng-global-thermal-sapper-charge.name: Global Thermal Sapper Charge
eng-global-thermal-sapper-charge.notes: Engineering-only utility consumable. Stronger if PvP/raid users are active.

eng-cobalt-frag-bomb.name: Cobalt Frag Bomb
eng-cobalt-frag-bomb.notes: Cheaper Wrath bomb. Good small-stack convenience item.

eng-box-of-bombs.name: Box of Bombs
eng-box-of-bombs.notes: Leveling/craft item. Price from Saronite Bar + Volatile Blasting Trigger.

eng-mammoth-cutters.name: Mammoth Cutters
eng-mammoth-cutters.notes: Hunter ammo market may exist depending on this server's rules. Check actual demand before making many.

eng-saronite-razorheads.name: Saronite Razorheads
eng-saronite-razorheads.notes: Hunter ammo market may exist depending on this server's rules. Post smaller batches first.

eng-adamantite-shells.name: Adamantite Shells
eng-adamantite-shells.notes: Old ammo. Only post if hunters/alts buy it on this server.

eng-fel-iron-casing.name: Fel Iron Casing
eng-fel-iron-casing.notes: Core TBC Engineering part. Made from Fel Iron Bar.

eng-handful-of-fel-iron-bolts.name: Handful of Fel Iron Bolts
eng-handful-of-fel-iron-bolts.notes: Common TBC Engineering part. Good leveler convenience item.

eng-elemental-blasting-powder.name: Elemental Blasting Powder
eng-elemental-blasting-powder.notes: Made from Motes. Used in TBC Engineering leveling/crafts.

eng-adamantite-frame.name: Adamantite Frame
eng-adamantite-frame.notes: Higher TBC Engineering part. Slow but valuable if scarce.

eng-khorium-power-core.name: Khorium Power Core
eng-khorium-power-core.notes: Rare TBC Engineering part. Only list if Khorium supply supports the margin.

eng-felsteel-stabilizer.name: Felsteel Stabilizer
eng-felsteel-stabilizer.notes: Used in older Engineering recipes. Singles first.

eng-hardened-adamantite-tube.name: Hardened Adamantite Tube
eng-hardened-adamantite-tube.notes: Niche TBC Engineering part. Slow but can sell high when someone needs one.

eng-thorium-widget.name: Thorium Widget
eng-thorium-widget.notes: Late Classic Engineering part and Darkmoon-style turn-in item if that demand exists here.

eng-thorium-tube.name: Thorium Tube
eng-thorium-tube.notes: Late Classic Engineering part. Singles sell best.

eng-truesilver-transformer.name: Truesilver Transformer
eng-truesilver-transformer.notes: Old Engineering component. Can spike if supply is empty.

eng-mithril-tube.name: Mithril Tube
eng-mithril-tube.notes: Mid-level Engineering tube used in scopes, gadgets, and leveling paths. Price from Mithril Bars plus convenience.

eng-mithril-casing.name: Mithril Casing
eng-mithril-casing.notes: Important mid-level Engineering part. Often used by levelers.

eng-unstable-trigger.name: Unstable Trigger
eng-unstable-trigger.notes: Engineering component. Price from Mithril + Mageweave-style inputs.

eng-iron-strut.name: Iron Strut
eng-iron-strut.notes: Engineering component made from Iron Bar. Singles/5s.

eng-bronze-framework.name: Bronze Framework
eng-bronze-framework.notes: Classic Engineering part. Useful catch-up material.

eng-whirring-bronze-gizmo.name: Whirring Bronze Gizmo
eng-whirring-bronze-gizmo.notes: Used in Engineering leveling/crafts. Good small-stack item.

eng-bronze-tube.name: Bronze Tube
eng-bronze-tube.notes: Engineering part and quest/craft item. Singles sell well.

eng-silver-contact.name: Silver Contact
eng-silver-contact.notes: Low-level Engineering part. Good exact-count item.

eng-copper-modulator.name: Copper Modulator
eng-copper-modulator.notes: Low-level Engineering part. Also sometimes used for turn-ins on older systems.

eng-copper-tube.name: Copper Tube
eng-copper-tube.notes: Early Engineering part. Good for levelers.

eng-handful-of-copper-bolts.name: Handful of Copper Bolts
eng-handful-of-copper-bolts.notes: Very common low-level Engineering part. Post small stacks.

eng-fused-wiring.name: Fused Wiring
eng-fused-wiring.notes: Awkward old Engineering component. Scarce supply can make it worth more.

eng-dense-blasting-powder.name: Dense Blasting Powder
eng-dense-blasting-powder.notes: Made from Dense Stone. Used in late Classic Engineering.

eng-solid-blasting-powder.name: Solid Blasting Powder
eng-solid-blasting-powder.notes: Made from Solid Stone. Useful for Engineering levelers.

eng-heavy-blasting-powder.name: Heavy Blasting Powder
eng-heavy-blasting-powder.notes: Made from Heavy Stone. Good small-stack item.

eng-coarse-blasting-powder.name: Coarse Blasting Powder
eng-coarse-blasting-powder.notes: Made from Coarse Stone. Early Engineering bottleneck.

eng-rough-blasting-powder.name: Rough Blasting Powder
eng-rough-blasting-powder.notes: Made from Rough Stone. Early Engineering item; small stacks only.

alch-flask-frost-wyrm.name: Flask of the Frost Wyrm
alch-flask-frost-wyrm.notes: Major raid flask. Price from Frost Lotus + Lichbloom/Icethorn + vial cost.

alch-flask-endless-rage.name: Flask of Endless Rage
alch-flask-endless-rage.notes: Major raid flask. Usually moves with raid schedule and Frost Lotus price.

alch-flask-stoneblood.name: Flask of Stoneblood
alch-flask-stoneblood.notes: Tank raid flask. Demand can be smaller but steady.

alch-flask-pure-mojo.name: Flask of Pure Mojo
alch-flask-pure-mojo.notes: Healer/caster utility flask. Often slower than Frost Wyrm.

alch-potion-speed.name: Potion of Speed
alch-potion-speed.notes: Common raid pre-pot/combat potion. Price from herbs + demand, not just mat cost.

alch-potion-wild-magic.name: Potion of Wild Magic
alch-potion-wild-magic.notes: Common caster/healer burst potion. Strong raid-night demand.

alch-indestructible-potion.name: Indestructible Potion
alch-indestructible-potion.notes: Tank pre-pot/combat utility. Smaller buyer pool but meaningful demand.

alch-runic-healing-potion.name: Runic Healing Potion
alch-runic-healing-potion.notes: General utility potion. High competition possible.

alch-runic-mana-potion.name: Runic Mana Potion
alch-runic-mana-potion.notes: General mana potion. Good small stacks.

alch-crazy-alchemists-potion.name: Crazy Alchemist's Potion
alch-crazy-alchemists-potion.notes: Only useful to Alchemists. Do not overbuild.

alch-pygmy-oil.name: Pygmy Oil
alch-pygmy-oil.notes: Made from Pygmy Suckerfish. Check oil vs fish value before converting.

alch-primal-might.name: Primal Might
alch-primal-might.notes: Important older Alchemy transmute product. Cooldown scarcity may not apply on this server.

inscription-materials-ah-price-guide.htm.intro_description: Every row below is an actual tradeable item that can be posted on the Auction House. Prices are per finished item. Check the current AH and your reagent cost before crafting a batch; on this server, short or absent profession cooldowns do not justify a cooldown premium.

sections.title: Crafted buff scrolls
sections.description: Manufactured raid and stat consumables. Rank VIII stat scrolls can also drop, but the finished items are identical and AH-tradeable.

sections.title: Crafted utility and BoE equipment
sections.description: Tradeable Inscription outputs beyond glyphs and cards. BoP shoulder inscriptions and scribe-only recall scrolls are intentionally excluded.

sections.title: Death Knight glyphs
sections.description: Curated level-80 raid and tanking demand.

sections.title: Druid glyphs
sections.description: Curated Balance, Feral, Restoration, and tank demand.

sections.title: Hunter glyphs
sections.description: Curated level-80 PvE demand across the common Hunter builds.

sections.title: Mage glyphs
sections.description: Curated Arcane, Fire, Frostfire, and utility demand.

sections.title: Paladin glyphs
sections.description: Curated Protection, Holy, and Retribution demand.

sections.title: Priest glyphs
sections.description: Curated Shadow, Discipline, and Holy demand.

sections.title: Rogue glyphs
sections.description: Curated Assassination and Combat demand.

sections.title: Shaman glyphs
sections.description: Curated Elemental and Restoration demand.

sections.title: Warlock glyphs
sections.description: Curated Affliction, Demonology, and Destruction demand.

sections.title: Warrior glyphs
sections.description: Curated Protection and physical-DPS demand.

sections.title: Nobles cards
sections.description: Exact Greatness-set cards. Price each missing card by scarcity rather than treating the whole set as one generic item.

sections.title: Chaos cards
sections.description: Exact Berserker-set cards.

sections.title: Prisms cards
sections.description: Exact Illusion-set cards.

sections.title: Undeath cards
sections.description: Exact Death-set cards.

sections.title: Completed Northrend decks
sections.description: Tradeable assembled decks only. The quest-reward trinkets are BoP and are not listed.

engineering-materials-ah-price-guide.htm.intro_description: Every row below is an actual tradeable Engineering output that can be posted on the Auction House. Prices are per finished item or listed stack. Check the current AH and live reagent cost before crafting a batch; server-specific profession, ammunition, PvP, and raid rules can change demand.

sections.title: Northrend crafted Engineering parts
sections.description: Tradeable Wrath components and utility tools used for leveling, devices, scopes, and other crafts.

sections.title: Bombs / sapper charges
sections.description: Tradeable Engineering explosives; demand depends on Hellscream's PvP, raid, and profession-use rules.

sections.title: Ammo
sections.description: Tradeable projectile ammunition; verify Hunter demand and server ammunition rules before making large batches.

sections.title: Outland crafted Engineering parts
sections.description: Tradeable Burning Crusade components commonly needed for Engineering leveling and older recipes.

sections.title: Classic crafted Engineering parts
sections.description: Tradeable Classic components used by levelers, quests, gadgets, and legacy recipes.

sections.title: Blasting powders
sections.description: Tradeable blasting powders made from matching stone tiers or elemental reagents.

alchemy-materials-ah-price-guide.html.intro_description: Every row below is an actual tradeable Alchemy output that can be posted on the Auction House. Prices are per finished item or listed stack. Check the current AH, live reagent cost, and any server-specific potion, flask, transmute, or proc behavior before crafting a batch.

sections.title: Crafted Wrath flasks
sections.description: Tradeable raid flasks made by Alchemists. Price from the current herb, Frost Lotus, vial, and specialization-proc economics rather than a fixed margin alone.

sections.title: Crafted Wrath potions
sections.description: Tradeable combat and recovery potions. Raid-night demand, profession requirements, and this server's potion rules can materially change sell-through.

sections.title: Crafted oils and transmuted materials
sections.description: Tradeable intermediate Alchemy outputs. Compare the finished item directly with its inputs before converting.
